protocol.title: Development of new geographic atrophy in neovascular (wet) AMD: ranibizumab vs aflibercept (RIVAL)
protocol.design: Randomised 1:1 aflibercept 2.0 mg vs ranibizumab 0.5 mg; three monthly injections, then inject and extend by disease activity to Month 24

anchors.label: Screening (Visit 1)
anchors.question: On what date was the Screening visit (up to 2 weeks before Baseline)?

questions.label: Woman of child-bearing potential
questions.text: Is the participant a woman of child-bearing potential?

overrides.note: Visit 4 (Week 8): third injection; the first interval decision

finding.label: Signs of disease activity (VA loss of 5+ letters, new retinal haemorrhage, IRF/SRF on OCT)

steps.label: Two or more signs: back to 4-weekly

adaptive.quote: However, on the fourth extension, or any extension thereafter, the maximum interval will be 2 weeks less than the maximum interval at which disease activity previously occurred in any of the three previous extensions

visits.name: Month 12 (Week 52)
visits.condition: Injection given here only if one is due within this visit's window

study_events.label: Novartis terminated the study early

actions.label: Early Discontinuation visit as soon as possible
actions.effect: Seen as soon as possible for the Early Discontinuation assessments; no further study visits.

study_events.quote: The study can be terminated at any time for any reason by Novartis. Should this be necessary, the patient should be seen as soon as possible and undergo assessments as described in Table 6-1 for an Early Discontinuation Visit.

open_points.text: Visits 3 and 4 (Weeks 4 and 8) allow only 3 days either side (Table 6-1); the model gives every treatment visit the 7-day window of the variable visits.
open_points.quote: it is essential that the treatment period be strictly adhered to during the period of the first three consecutive doses
open_points.used: +/-7 days for all treatment visits; staff keep Visits 3 and 4 within +/-3 days.

open_points.text: 'In any of the three previous extensions' is read as: only activity found at the end of an interval that an extension reached counts toward the break point; activity during the 4-weekly loading phase does not.
open_points.quote: However, on the fourth extension, or any extension thereafter, the maximum interval will be 2 weeks less than the maximum interval at which disease activity previously occurred in any of the three previous extensions
open_points.used: Break point from intervals reached by an extension; recorded once and kept for the rest of the study.

open_points.text: The reading centre's recommendation 'of when this next visit should occur' is recorded as an interval in weeks. The investigator's calculated interval books the visit until it arrives; then the recommendation replaces it.
open_points.quote: The investigator should adjust the visit schedule in line with the central reading centre recommendation.

open_points.text: The next treatment visit is counted from the previous visit's recorded date; the injection itself may be given up to 7 days after the visit.
open_points.quote: should be administered in the study eye on the day of the study visit or, if this is not possible, within 7 days after the occurrence of the study visit
open_points.used: Interval counted from the recorded visit date.

open_points.text: An injection due within the Month 12 window is given at the Month 12 visit on its target date; otherwise Month 12 is attended without an injection.
open_points.quote: If patient is not due for another injection within the visit window of the Month 12 the patient should attend a visit and have all procedures except ranibizumab or aflibercept injection.
open_points.used: combine_with Month 12, on the Month 12 target date.

open_points.text: The plasma VEGF visits are 7 days after the Week 4 and Week 8 injections; the model dates them from Baseline (Weeks 5 and 9, Table 6-1), not from the recorded injection dates.
open_points.quote: Blood for plasma VEGF is being collected at Baseline and again at 7 days after the injection at Week 4 (Visit 3) and 7 days after the injection at Week 8 (Visit 4).

open_points.text: A withheld injection (IOP of 30 mm Hg or more, or an untreated retinal tear) is not modelled: the visit is recorded without the injection and its finding still sets the next interval.
open_points.quote: Ranibizumab or aflibercept treatment should be withheld and treatment should not be resumed earlier than the next scheduled treatment in the event of
open_points.used: No automatic change; staff note the withheld dose.

notes: Injections due at Week 104 are given after the study (page 27): treatment visits stop at Week 103.
The shortest interval between doses is 28 days (page 31).
